messages:
Emma: :rotating_light: Opening war room — multiple premium customers are reporting 5xx and timeouts for hosted inference in us-east1. Some reports mention auth failures and an unusual billing spike. Escalating to infra + billing.

support-bot: Incoming aggregated alerts from the hosted gateway: 5xx rate up 7x, p95 latency up 2.3x. Top error codes: 502, 504, 401 (auth). See https://observability/redwood/alerts/1902 for details.

Raj: Looking at gateway traces — a lot of 401 -> 502 patterns. Auth service appears to be timing out and gateway surfaces 502s. Also seeing a DB connection exhaustion on auth-db around 03:12 UTC.

Maria: Confirming high token validation latency. Cache miss rate jumped at 03:10. We had an experiment rolled yesterday that toggled auth cache for per-tenant validation. cc @Alex — did we flip something in prod-us-east1?

Alex: Yep, we rolled a per-tenant billing enrichment experiment at 03:10 that touched the auth validation path (was trying to enrich tokens with billing metadata). Rolling back that change now. Command I'm running: kubectl set env deployment/auth-service AUTH_CACHE_ENABLED=true --namespace=prod-us-east1

incident-bot: Deploy rollback started by Alex at 2026-03-15T03:22:10Z. CI job: https://ci.redwood/jobs/4382

Emma: Mitigation plan: (A) enable stale-token acceptance at the gateway to avoid hard 401/502s while auth recovers, (B) increase upstream auth timeout from 1s -> 3s, (C) revert billing enrichment. Can we do (A) and (B) immediately?

Raj: I'll flip gateway flags now. Using ops API: curl -XPOST https://ops-api/flags/gateway -d '{"accept_stale_tokens":true,"upstream_timeout_ms":3000}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN"

Maria: Scaling auth replicas +1 and bumping DB pool size to prevent connection thrash: pg_ctl reload and `kubectl scale deployment/auth-db --replicas=3 -n prod-us-east1`. Doing now.

Luis: Billing team observed malformed meter payloads from the new SDK enrichment; that caused higher CPU and slower responses in billing-processor, which in turn saturated the shared auth-db connection pool (we use it for tenant lookups). Rolling SDK revert and disabling enrichment.

Alex: Rollback completed at 03:35 UTC — auth service now running with AUTH_CACHE_ENABLED=true. Gateway flag update propagated 03:37 UTC. I can see 5xx rate dropping in the dash.

Emma: Support — start notifying highest-impact customers. Sophie, can you own the customer outreach and credits?

Sophie: On it. Drafting messages and will send to affected accounts in the next 30m. Also opening a Jira for postmortem and customer credits.

Raj: Quick repro notes for PM: curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' -d '{"model":"redwood-v2","input":"hello"}' https://hosted.redwood.ai/v1/generate when auth cache disabled + billing enrichment enabled will cause auth-service latency spikes -> gateway 502s after auth upstream timeouts.

Maria: Relevant log snippets:

```
[03:12:17] auth-service ERROR validate_token failed: timeout after 2000ms tenant=acme request_id=xyz123
[03:12:18] gateway WARN upstream error 502 auth-service timeout token=abc123 request_id=xyz124
[03:12:19] billing-processor ERROR enrichment failed: malformed payload tenant=acme
```

Alex: Traffic numbers: premium customer traffic peaked with 18% 5xx; overall hosted traffic 5xx spike ~7x baseline. Token validation p95 went from 45ms -> 980ms during the incident window.

Emma: Action items (owners):
- Create postmortem doc and customer outreach (Sophie)
- Add rollout guard for auth-cache flips + require canary test (Alex)
- Revert SDK and add integration tests for billing enrichment (Luis)
- Tune alerts to fire on auth validation p50/p95 before 5xx surface (Maria)
- Add gateway fallback config and test stale-token acceptance behavior (Raj)
- Run a simulated load test for token enrichment path (all: infra + billing)

Sophie: Postmortem ticket created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RINF-5123 — assigning owners and due dates. Draft outreach for affected customers uploaded to the ticket.

Luis: I'll follow up with the SDK team to add server-side contract tests and a short-term throttle on enrichment.

Raj: I'll roll a canary check into the deployment pipeline to validate no auth-db pressure before global rollout.

Maria: I'll add an alert that triggers when auth-db connections > 70% or token validation p95 > 250ms.

Emma: Thanks everyone — closing the war room and moving to async follow-ups. Please update the Jira with timelines and link any PRs. :white_check_mark:

Sophie: Will send customer messages and postmortem summary by EOD.

support-bot: Incident summary: root cause: simultaneous auth-cache disable + billing enrichment causing DB thrash -> auth timeouts -> gateway 502s. Mitigations: rollback, gateway fallback, scale auth-db. Postmortem ticket: RINF-5123.

Alex: Leaving a note for postmortem: require performance regression checks when touching auth path.

Emma: Great work everyone.
